prompt: Check githubstatus.com and tell me whether all GitHub services are working normally right now.

says.text: Still working: my first script returned nothing, so I'm trying a simpler way to pull the status text off the page.

Yes. githubstatus.com says **"All Systems Operational"** right now (checked 2026-10-29), and it shows no active incidents.

All 11 services it tracks are marked **Normal** today. The figures are uptime over the past 60 days:

| Service | Today | 60-day uptime |
|---|---|---|
| Git Operations | Normal | 99.99% |
| Webhooks | Normal | 99.98% |
| API Requests | Normal | 100% |
| Issues | Normal | 100% |

| Pages | Normal | 100% |
